examples.condition: The existing IA108 workflow must not be repurposed for slot1 because it is self-hosted, write-enabled, checks out another branch and publishes shared state.
A historical workflow file found in commit history is not an available execution path when the target-branch readback is 404.
No workflow may be triggered until a slot-only, read-only or explicitly approved receipt contract exists on the target branch.
A GitHub Actions artifact is an evidence carrier and never a broadband product row by itself.
Artifact receipts must record run ID, commit SHA, creation time and expected expiry because artifacts are retained for a limited period.
Because the OS Downloads API does not expose previous OpenData releases, the retrieval timestamp and product metadata must be pinned before download.
An OS download query returning more than one candidate must fail closed rather than choosing the first file.
Every redirect hop and final byte URL must be recorded; a documentation URL alone is not a byte receipt.
Optional provider MD5 metadata must be checked when present, and a local SHA-256 must still be computed from the downloaded bytes.
A single full-GB OS Open UPRN file cannot be counted as exact slot rows until the target identifiers are deterministically extracted.
An HMLR local-authority file must be pinned by authority, publication month and downloaded-byte hash before any polygon join.
A new monthly HMLR file must not silently overwrite an older join receipt; both snapshot identities must remain distinguishable.
BDUK current-connectivity fields represent BDUK's programme view and cannot replace Ofcom corrected-r2 coverage.
BDUK future commercial plans must never be treated as current gigabit availability.
A three-year NR OMR planning horizon cannot raise the current broadband accuracy score of any legacy example.
Without downloaded bytes, hashes and exact UPRN-title-postcode-r2 joins, official rows, upgraded rows and business writes remain zero.
